thread:
ada: throwing an idea into the room: add a compact "forensics" control on rollout rules that combines budget + adaptive sampling + quick-snapshot.
ryan: yes please. ops wants predictable cost but fast access during incidents. we should let rule authors pick between "budgeted" and "burstable" forensic modes.
leah: UI suggestion: in rule row show a small pill "Forensics: budgeted". click opens a tiny flyout with: monthly_budget, baseline_rate, burst_rate, burst_threshold, include_payload toggle, and a "force snapshot" button.
ada: (typo) ada: also add an estimate line: "~X traces/hr (~$Y/hr) at current QPS" based on recent 15m QPS. that helps owners choose numbers.
ryan: backend needs: decision header (X-Fallback-Audit: id|sampled|rate|reason) emitted pre-tokenize, and a cheap evaluator at edge. store decision metadata even if we don't capture payloads.
leah: capture schema: prompt_hash, kv_keys, model_variant, decision_path, policy_id, trace_id, timestamp. include_payload=false by default. include_payload=true requires tenant opt-in.
audit-bot: scheduled probe: forensic-burst-check-1744 at 2024-09-07T02:30:00Z. will post sampling/size metrics. :robot_face:
ryan: need overflow handling: if effective_rate * QPS > storage_rps then we throttle and emit audit.burst.throttled with reason. console should show a red banner and propose mitigations.
leah: mitigations: auto-reduce burst_rate, convert to budgeted-mode, or escalate to admin for temporary top-up. show one-click actions.
ryan: also want an explainability toast when adaptive bump happens: "Sampling increased for rule rr-33 due to 120 errors in 2m (burst threshold)." link to recent traces.
security-bot: reminder: payload capture defaults: off. when on, run redaction pipeline + encrypt with tenant KMS. retention default 7d and must be editable via support request. emergency snapshots require 2 approvers for regulated tenants.
ada: ada: quick mock config snippet for SDKs/console:
```yaml
policy_id: p-77
rules:
  - id: rr-33
    match: response.code == 500
    fallback: graceful_small
    forensics:
      mode: burstable
      monthly_budget: 10000
      baseline_rate: 0.001
      burst_rate: 0.1
      burst_threshold: 50 # errors per 120s
      burst_ttl_s: 1800
      include_payload: false
```
ryan: metrics to emit: audit.sample.requested, audit.sample.accepted, audit.sample.dropped_quota, audit.burst.triggered, audit.burst.throttled. these back the console gauges.
leah: UX microcopy: when include_payload=false show "Replay via hashed snapshot (no PII)" and when true show "Replay with encrypted payload (tenant KMS)". be explicit about retention.
ryan: for replay service, hashed snapshot + kv_keys + model_variant + decision_path should be enough to rehydrate a deterministic run in sandbox. if include_payload true, allow full replay.
audit-bot: test scheduled; will post results in thread.
security-bot: filing follow-up SEC-4011 to formalize redaction tooling and retention approvals.
ada: ada: next steps: leah will produce a tiny flyout mock + cost calc, ryan will spec the header and edge evaluator, security-bot will draft enroll/opt-in checklist. i'll write a short RFC and attach mocks.
leah: will post Figma links by EOD.
ryan: will PR header proto draft.
ada: thanks all, reconvene after audit-bot results. :thumbsup:
